entities.name: Mia
entities.description: A farmer and shepherd from Nephalia on Innistrad, daughter of Olgard, who becomes a servant of the Gitrog monster.

entities.name: Olgard
entities.description: Monster slayer, Mia's father, away living among the Skiltfolk.

entities.name: Wilbur
entities.description: Mia's friend and romantic interest, her first sacrifice to the Gitrog.

entities.name: Gitrog Monster
entities.description: A monster living in Lake Zhava that the villagers sacrificed to.

entities.name: Lake Zhava
entities.description: Lake near Mia's village, home of the Gitrog monster.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: Region of Innistrad where Mia lives.

events.summary: Mia follows the tracks of her missing sheep to Lake Zhava and discovers the villagers sacrifice them to the Gitrog.
events.quote: she discovered that the villagers had been stealing her sheep to give as sacrifice to the Gitrog monster

events.summary: The Gitrog attacks and eats the villagers; Mia and Wilbur flee by swimming.
events.quote: One by one, it snapped the villagers into its mouth with its enormous tongue

events.summary: Gazing into the Gitrog's eyes, Mia understands she was made to serve it and sacrifices Wilbur.
events.quote: Her first sacrifice to the Gitrog was Wilbur.

events.summary: In spring Mia lures a messenger with a letter from her father onto the lake as her next sacrifice.
events.quote: Mia smiled beautifully at her next sacrifice.

relations.quote: the daughter of the monster slayer Olgard
she was made to serve it with sacrifice
with whom she had a romantic interest
